title: Daily Devotional #64
paragraphs: As I read Luke 20, I am struck by the encounter between the religious leaders and Jesus. They challenge Him and question His authority, but Jesus responds with wisdom and truth. He tells a parable about a landowner who sent servants to collect the harvest from his vineyard, but the tenants beat and mistreated them. Finally, the landowner sends his son, hoping they will respect him, but they kill him. Jesus concludes the parable by saying, "The stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone" (Luke 20:17).

Lord, I am reminded that You are the cornerstone of our faith. You are the foundation upon which we build our lives. Without You, we are lost and adrift, searching for meaning and purpose. But with You, we have a solid foundation upon which to stand, and we can live with confidence and hope.

Lord, help me to remember that You are always with me, guiding and directing me. When I face challenges or difficult circumstances, help me to turn to You for wisdom and strength. And when I feel lost or alone, help me to remember that You are my rock and my salvation.
Lord, thank You for Your love and grace. Thank You for being the cornerstone of my faith. May I always seek to follow You and honor You in all that I do. Amen.
